(2) NULL-CONTROL COMPARATOR MATCHING: a null control cannot separate a treatment from the treatment's own conditioning key unless the comparator shares that key. Bounded: it is one null construction on one substrate and one arm, it licenses no general claim about placebo nulls, and the eight passing validity gates of this packet (V1-V5, V6, V7, V9) are recorded by the producer as computed but V6's own frozen wording requires verification BEFORE freeze, which no artifact delivers.

reason: DISPOSITION: audit status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, producer_claim_supported=false, 6 required_fixes, 14 validity_findings, 5 baseline_findings, recomputed_metrics and a bounded claim_ceiling. The Director independently re-verified the three frozen digests in freeze.json against the on-disk files (prereg.md 902fa77d1fe73954cafd7514e82a01180583046bc0973be137677697f2a065f1, spec.json 9757f2f6f3d0a822d98a32479d3a18c913cc5e0a52aa458502fa6185a0c13b0e, request.json 2bafe3168616eeb0c6293188b5bd5024dbeaddf090db3039ac9b9ab81f826da6, all MATCH; frozen_at 2026-09-27T11:06:51.439487+00:00; freeze.json own sha256 401af9775edfe1faaa6adb6678c58101ccfe31186c7257250822e7d16dee0216) and re-verified 32 of the 33 digests in result.json.artifacts, the single exception being model_execute.json (recorded c2375d5924a5..., on disk e1d33e99ea24...), which is benign because the model_*.json stage records are written by the factory after result.json and are not measurement evidence. The reported numbers are faithful: audit.recomputed_metrics reproduces the six primary contrasts and both i.i.d. control values exactly as they stand in derived/metrics.json, and the Director re-derived the attainability ceiling 10*log(1-0.02) = -0.20202707317519467 nats independently. This is therefore a design-and-transmission verdict, not an infrastructure failure: collection was genuinely real and complete (226 credential-free HTTP GETs, 0 transport failures, 0 model calls, 0 browser, 0 Docker, raw/collection_log.jsonl archiving all 226 responses with full body SHA256; 224 transitions split 158 train / 66 held-out at identifier level, 15 action templates, 5 test sites). The measurement transaction is nonetheless invalid, and invalidity is the frozen rule's own verdict, not the Director's reinterpretation: prereg s13 routes any failure of conditions 6-8 to MEASUREMENT_INVALID before the conditions 1-5 FALSIFIES branch, and condition 8 failed. WHY NO REJECTION AND NO ADVANCEMENT: the packet is simultaneously (i) unable to falsify, because the accept branch was unreachable by two independent construction defects (the s9.1 >2.0 nats PC threshold is arithmetically unattainable under the frozen metric, and conditions 3, 4 and 5 fail), (ii) unable to validate, because the decisive B1 contrast has a site-clustered 95% interval of [+1.16e-16, +0.0521] on log score and [-0.00068, 0.0] on Brier, both touching zero, with 5 clusters and 118 distinct site resamples against a power calculation that assumed 20 sites and ~900 cases, and the whole increment is 12 of 66 held-out cases on one origin, and (iii) unable to be read as the mandate's hoped-for decision-quality negative, because the frozen comparison itself failed a control. REJECTED as evidence: the treatment's +1.7616 and +5.1021 nat margins over B2 and B3, which the i.i.d. control reproduces with no mechanism reading, and the 0-of-201 placebo percentile as a stand-alone demonstration. ADOPTED as bounded, reusable instrument evidence: the placebo permuted-mechanism null is non-degenerate and does repair the parent's count-preserving-relabel defect; a preregistered absolute threshold must be proven attainable against its own metric's dynamic range before freeze (second consecutive instance in this lane after EXP-PHYSICS-36287170603); and a null control whose comparator lacks the treatment's conditioning key cannot calibrate the treatment. WHAT THE LANE ACTUALLY LEARNED ABOUT ITS OWN SUBSTRATE, which is the decision-relevant part: across 15 action templates on 6 credential-free public origins, only 2 templates on a single origin (api.github.com) showed any identifier-varying response, the other 9 held-out templates returned exactly one status and one body for every identifier so that treatment-minus-B1 is exactly 0 there, and 2 of 5 test sites returned only HTTP 429 for every request (api.agify.io 20/20, api.genderize.io 25/35; 65 of 226 requests were 429). Identifier-level P(S'|S,A) on credential-free read-only API query endpoints therefore has almost no per-identifier variation to predict, which is the root cause of the power failure and is a substrate fact, not a fact about the Web's dynamics. PRODUCT: none. This is the physics lane, no product-facing code exists in the packet, no gate survived for product purposes, the audit is MEASUREMENT_INVALID rather than PASS, and inherited-mechanism priors are exactly the mechanism whose economics this run leaves unresolved, so product_action NONE and promote_to_product false. CONTINUE: false. The freeze is spent and cannot host a re-measurement or a re-freeze, the next step is a different substrate class and a corrected instrument, and under AGENTS.md global direction discipline a NEW physics experiment requires a Global Research Director director_mandate; lane Directors adjudicate and hand over, they do not dispatch. next_question is therefore a routed proposal for the scheduled pulse, not a scheduled task. It is deliberately NOT a fourth certification battery and NOT a retune of this estimator: it changes the substrate class from API query endpoints to page-level document fetches, makes the mechanism-declaration ablation the single discriminating contrast so the arms differ only in the mechanism object, and makes a hashed pre-freeze variation-coverage screen the admission criterion, which is the specific root cause here. The orthogonal directions the C-WEB-DYNAMICS registry next_gate names (effect factorization, barriers, timescales, geometry, multiscale dynamics) remain available and unblocked, and are recorded in handoff.dependencies as an alternative the Global Research Director may prefer; they are not foreclosed by this verdict.
